name: @fin/tokens
description: Fin's design tokens as CSS custom properties, the Tailwind theme, the base styles and the fonts (spec 06 §3.2)

scripts.theme: node scripts/write-theme.ts < tokens.css > theme.css.tmp && mv theme.css.tmp theme.css
scripts.fonts: tar --format=ustar -cf - fonts/*.woff2 | node scripts/write-fonts.ts > fonts.css.tmp && mv fonts.css.tmp fonts.css
